text:
reena_cs: Quick pre-call note for Polaris II private onboarding (enablement tomorrow 10:00 PT). Top outstanding: KMS key access pattern, CloudTrail to customer bucket, IAM role mapping, and peering MTU.

omar_sre: Peering established. Seeing occasional MSS drops on TCP path; set MSS clamp to 1410 on transit.

tara_net: @lucas_polaris please confirm firewall change. We need egress 443 to 172.31.45.6/32 and route: 10.130.0.0/16 -> 172.31.45.6.

lucas_polaris: Security will allow the IP. ASN is 64530, ops contact infra@polaris.io. Will update route and firewall by EOD.

reena_cs: On KMS: Polaris asked for a CMK with stricter rotation. Recommend use of symmetric CMK with automatic rotation enabled unless your compliance needs external HSM. Sample key policy will be posted in the call notes.

lucas_polaris: Our compliance prefers 14-day rotation. If KMS auto-rotate is insufficient, we may need to bring wrapped DEKs. Is Redwood able to accept wrapped keys?

omar_sre: We can support wrapped DEKs if you provide a stable unwrap endpoint and we can validate during enablement. KMS preferred for simplicity.

reena_cs: Audit logs: we support CloudTrail delivery to your bucket + optional SNS for near-real-time alerts. Please share bucket ARN and preferred prefix (we recommend `redwood/`).

ops-bot: Reminder: Polaris II enablement scheduled 2026-07-08 10:00 PT. Zoom in calendar.

lucas_polaris: Will share bucket ARN and confirm firewall change before the call. Noted renewal risk: internal launch planned 10d after onboarding; flagging medium risk until perf tests pass.

reena_cs: Action items: lucas -> bucket ARN + firewall update; tara -> MSS clamp snippet + route example; omar -> wrapped DEK checklist. I'll post checklist later today. :thumbsup:
